# How much of your company do your SAFEs actually cost you?

> Free SAFE dilution calculator for startup founders. Model post-money and pre-money SAFEs with caps and discounts converting in a priced round with an option pool top-up: your cap table, what each SAFE cost you, valuation sensitivity and an exit waterfall. Illustrative; nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
